# chameleon_warehouse (Data Source)

Fetch details of an existing Chameleon warehouse.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_warehouse" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}

output "warehouse_description" {
  value = data.chameleon_warehouse.analytics.description
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Warehouse name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Warehouse description.
- `id` (String) Warehouse name (matches `name`).
